description: External skill packages that are reinstalled from source (not vendored). The install script uses this manifest to fetch each source and recreate the skill symlinks under ~/.claude/skills.

gstack.install_hint: gstack ships its own installer and manages ~/.claude/skills/gstack + all gstack skill symlinks. Once the `gstack` binary is present, its skills self-register.

taste-skill.install_hint: Clone the repo, then symlink each installed skill name to the repo's SKILL.md.

clerk.install_hint: Clerk agent skills live in ~/.agents/skills and are installed via Clerk's agent toolkit (e.g. `npx @clerk/agent-toolkit@latest install` or the clerk CLI). Each installed name is symlinked from ~/.claude/skills/<name> -> ../../.agents/skills/<name>.

claude-seo.install_hint: Runs claude-seo's own installer, which copies 31 skills into ~/.claude/skills, 18 subagents into ~/.claude/agents, and builds a Python venv at ~/.claude/skills/seo/.venv. Pin the tag with CLAUDE_SEO_TAG=<tag>. Needs python3 >= 3.10 + git. All 8 extensions install by default; each extension's own API keys are configured separately (none are stored in this repo).

caveman.install_hint: Official Claude Code path: `claude plugin marketplace add JuliusBrussee/caveman && claude plugin install caveman@caveman`. Do NOT use the upstream curl|bash installer — it rewrites Claude Code hooks and the statusline, which would clobber statusline-command.sh. All 20 skills and 3 agents ship inside the plugin, namespaced `caveman:<skill>`, so they never appear in ~/.claude/skills. The plugin also registers its own SessionStart hook, which is what keeps the compressed reply style active across sessions. skills/ upstream is MIT; the Caveman Engine/proxy is BSL-1.1 and is not installed by this path.

graphify.install_hint: uv tool install "graphifyy[mcp,sql,watch]" then `graphify install --platform claude` (writes ~/.claude/skills/graphify + a section in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md). NOTE: the global installer does NOT register hooks — only `--project` does — so the PreToolUse hook-guard entries in config/settings.json are maintained here instead, which keeps them global without writing CLAUDE.md/.claude into every work repo. The sql extra is required or .sql files index as empty; watch enables `graphify watch` for auto-rebuild.
graphify.mcp: graphify (see mcp/servers.json) — started with no default graph it runs as a pure multi-project server; every tool takes project_path.
graphify.indexed_projects: 17 Intelcia repos under ~/Work (GitLab intelcia-solutions + Azure DevOps PdpParagon/PDP). Each has graphify-out/ added to .git/info/exclude so it never shows in git status. Vendor-heavy repos carry a .graphifyignore.

omarchy.install_hint: Provided by the Omarchy desktop install (~/.local/share/omarchy). Symlink each skill name to its path in source_map; both live under default/agents/skills/ (upstream moved them there from default/omarchy-skill) and are absent on non-Omarchy machines.
